name: Zhi'ai Jieti Zhi Yin
source:
She just arrived in CELL… and the city instantly labeled her a monster. Now she runs for her life.

A girl who belongs to the brutal peacekeeping patrol of CELL, who refused her duty and locked herself in a robot.

In a city where cutting in line means death by law, one woman persists in pursuing judicial justice with an idealistic fervor.

So, how will your paths cross? Will you fight, flirt, or flee? Or all of the above?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3668550/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
她刚到达CELL……这座城市立即给她贴上了怪物的标签。现在她正在逃命。

一名属于CELL残酷维和巡逻队的女孩，她拒绝履行职责，将自己锁在机器人里。

在一个插队就意味着死亡的城市里，一名女性以理想主义的热情坚持追求司法正义。

那么，你们的道路将如何交叉？你会打架、调情还是逃跑？还是以上所有？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3668550/]Steam[/url]]
